# Final state verification
import os
print("=== crucible_hidden/ contents ===")
for f in sorted(os.listdir('crucible_hidden')):
    path = os.path.join('crucible_hidden', f)
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    with open(path) as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    test_count = content.count('def test_')
    print(f"  {f}: {test_count} tests, {size} bytes")

print("\n=== pytest results ===")
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command='python -m pytest -q crucible_hidden 2>&1 | tail -5')
print(str(r.get('content', r.get('error', '')))[:500])
